parameters: Merchant's Guild - MEMBERS ONLY
(Something tells you they don't want kids here either.)
Citizen: The Cave of Dread is Northeast of here and North
of Castle Corr.
Citizen: Castle Corr is Southeast of here.
Citizen: King Corr doesn't normally allow visitors into his
castle, not in general, although he's a nice guy in person
I hear.
\P[1]: We were told to go see him.
Citizen: Oh!  Well, if that's true, kids, I'm sure he'll
grant you an audience then.  He DOES like children and
families, and he does have special recognition programs that
reward good kids in schools and more, and they visit him.
Citizen: The supercity Yaster is to the Southeast, close to
the ocean.
Citizen: Shopping in Dundle isn't too bad for those who
come from S'mee'aliere Island, for those who can afford the
prices that is.
Kid: Gortish is a town really far south of here and is past
a lake and river with bridges going over it.  You can get
to it before you get to big mountains.
Kid: You know the magic rainbow if you go really far East of
here?  The one that's always there and is next to the pass
where King Corr's soldiers are?  Its there all year all the
time and people try to find a magic pot of gold under it.
They never found it!  Its a stupid joke after all, but
sometimes people go looking for it.  Its not real.
Citizen: Yaster Archology has some good stores to shop at,
even in Grade C, although they don't always sell everything
to just anybody.  They're like that, they're THOSE types of
merchants.
Citizen: Aren't vending machines nice when you find them in
Corr?  They sell all sorts of handy snacks that are good for
travel and keep a long time, but man do those machines get
sold out rather fast!  And they stay that way!
Citizen: The town of Gortish is on the south side of the
lake that is South and somewhat East of Dundle.  If you go
to the entrance to the Yaster Archology and follow the ocean
shore East, it runs into a river that goes to that lake.
